#middleeast #geopolitics #simonsebagmontefiore #foreignpolicy

Historian Simon Sebag Montefiore joins Tom and Patrick to discuss how the modern Middle East was forged and why the forces that shaped it are still at work today. Who is gaining power, who is losing it, and are we watching the birth of a new regional order?

Who do you think is reshaping the new Middle East? Get in touch: generalandjournalist@thetimes.co.uk

Chapters:

00:00 — How the modern Middle East was made
13:15 — Colonialism, Sykes-Picot and the birth of “zombie states”
23:45 — Is the term “Middle East” now obsolete?
29:30 — Iran’s regional empire and the October 7 wars
36:45 — Six converging theatres—and reasons for hope

The Cauldron: The Making of the Modern Middle
title: Is the Middle East as We Know It Coming to an End?
